unmodelled.text: Must be a resident of West Bengal
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.

unmodelled.text: Generally for the unemployed, underemployed, dropouts, job seekers or people upgrading skills
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should generally be unemployed, underemployed, a school/college dropout, job seeker or person seeking ski upgradation.

unmodelled.text: Must meet the selected course's own minimum age
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should meet the minimum age requirement prescribed for the selected course

unmodelled.text: Must meet the trade's minimum education
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should meet the minimum educational qualification required for the selected trade or training programme.

unmodelled.text: Women, weaker sections, minorities, SC, ST and persons with disabilities may get priority
unmodelled.source_quote: Women, economically weaker sections, minorities, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and persons with disabilities may receive priority under inclusive skill development objectives.

en.title: Utkarsh Bangla
en.benefit: Free short-term skill training in many trades, with certification and placement support.
en.how_to_apply: Register on the Utkarsh Bangla portal or at an approved training centre, District Skill Development Office, BDO or municipal office.
